title: Otter holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='35%' cy='30%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9db0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e8465f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b02240'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='26' rx='16' ry='19' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <polygon points='66,44 74,44 70,50' fill='#b02240'/>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M70 50 Q66 62 60 68 Q56 73 58 76' stroke='#ffd9a0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- otter body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='18' ry='17' fill='#8b5a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='78' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#c98a5e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='89' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6f4429'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='89' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6f4429'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='84' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#6f4429' transform='rotate(-20 22 84)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='54' r='16' fill='#8b5a3c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#6f4429'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#6f4429'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='60' rx='10' ry='7.5' fill='#e8c9a8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='55.5' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='51' r='2.4' fill='#2a1810'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='51' r='2.4' fill='#2a1810'/>
  <circle cx='35.8' cy='50.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='49.8' cy='50.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M32 59 L25 57 M32 61 L25 62 M52 59 L59 57 M52 61 L59 62' stroke='#f5e2c8' stroke-width='0.9' fill='none'/>
  <!-- arms: left raised to string, right down -->
  <path d='M55 66 Q60 68 58 74' stroke='#7a4d31' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='68' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#8b5a3c' transform='rotate(25 30 68)'/>
</svg>
